claim: Actual projective-line O(1) by two-chart clutching, coordinate sections, and actual contact pullback with five local frames
author: /root/restart_hodge_gluing
external_input_scope: No new literature theorem. Clutching is constructed in the actual module-sheaf category using pinned Mathlib limits; the O(1) convention is stated by its exact transition.

obligations.name: Source hypotheses
obligations.required: Clutching requires actual sheaf maps, unit transition, and full chart intersections before local freeness can be asserted.
obligations.constructed: The module is a categorical pullback of actual pushforward unit sheaves. Unit transition and full range equalities are proved separately.
obligations.why_match: Local frames are derived by preserving the pullback under restriction and showing one restricted comparison is an isomorphism on every subopen.

obligations.name: Constructed objects
obligations.required: O(1) must be constructed on the actual target independently of the source tensor square.
obligations.constructed: The target is ProjectiveJLine318.scheme Q; its line is clutched from its two genuine polynomial charts and the actual Laurent overlap.
obligations.why_match: The source module is separately defined by Scheme.Modules.pullback applied to that target line, not by an equality or alias to Omega tensor Omega.

obligations.name: Domain and index coverage
obligations.required: The whole overlap and both target charts, plus every source branch and infinity, must be included.
obligations.constructed: The entire overlap is Spec(Localization.Away X); both chart ranges and cartesian square are verified. The source has branchFrame for all Fin4 indices and infinityFrame.
obligations.why_match: Target frames_cover uses the actual two-chart cover. Source frame instances use the prior actual five-chart maps and all their structural squares.

obligations.name: Transition and comparison maps
obligations.required: The direction of the clutching equation and all pullback/restriction comparisons must be exact.
obligations.constructed: The equation is finite coefficient = t times infinity coefficient. The second map includes the actual route equality and multiplication by the literal overlap section.
obligations.why_match: The associated frames obey the O(1) convention e0=t e1. chartIso composes the canonical restriction/pullback, composition, equality and inverse composition isomorphisms in their stated directions.

obligations.name: Identity of the consumed object
obligations.required: The eventual comparison must concern the actual pullback and the existing actual source map.
obligations.constructed: ContactProjectiveLinePullback318.line literally invokes pullback of ContactBicanonicalProjectiveMap318.projectiveMap on ProjectiveLineOOne318.line.
obligations.why_match: Its local frames use the exact finite and reciprocal ratio maps already proved equal to the structural map. A global identification with the source tensor square is not asserted.

obligations.name: Coefficient and normalization conventions
obligations.required: The O(1)/O(-1) sign, homogeneous coordinate order and rational scalars must agree.
obligations.constructed: The overlap uses t and s with ts=1. The target sections have pairs(1,s) and(t,1), corresponding to X1 and X0, respectively.
obligations.why_match: Their four literal projection identities certify these pairs. The source map uses [q1:q0], consistent with t=q1/q0; no scalar rescaling is inserted.

obligations.name: Local conditions
obligations.required: Local frames must hold on whole charts, not only a dense generic locus, and pullback must not assume flatness.
obligations.constructed: The overlap is the exact full intersection; restricted comparison maps are isomorphisms on every subopen because their regular-function maps are those of the actual open immersions.
obligations.why_match: The unit transition preserves invertibility. Pullback frame transport uses only functorial isomorphisms and pullback of the unit, so no flatness or unproved exactness of arbitrary pullback is used.

obligations.name: Exceptional cases
obligations.required: Branch and infinity points, reciprocal zero, and allowed twist parameters must not be lost.
obligations.constructed: The target line has separate full finite and infinity frames, so neither target coordinate is inverted on its own entire chart. Source twists remain arbitrary rational units.
obligations.why_match: Only the overlap coordinate is inverted on the overlap. Source frame transport includes every branch and the full infinity neighborhood under their checked maps.

obligations.name: Downstream consumption
obligations.required: A separately constructed target line and actual pullback are needed before claiming a pullback-O(1) comparison or KS bridge.
obligations.constructed: This packet supplies the actual target sheaf, charts, coordinate sections/projections and actual source pullback with all local frames.
obligations.why_match: The global iso carrying pulled coordinate sections to contact q0/q1 is deliberately left for a later consuming join. PEL/KS and metric consumers remain unfilled.

consumer: Foundation for a still-open global isomorphism actual pullback O(1) ≅ Omega tensor Omega carrying coordinate sections to contact q0/q1.
not_claimed: normalization of pulled coordinate sections under all source frames
